mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the unemployment rate below 4.5% signals tightening labor market conditions that increase corporate hiring costs and inflationary pressure, leading to higher equity risk premiums and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE < 4.5%, or the average return in such periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in residential construction permits above 1.2 million units signals strong household demand and rising consumer confidence, which drives forward-looking equity valuations and generates positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the federal funds rate and a decline in the CPIAUCSL indicates a disinflationary monetary tightening cycle, where rate hikes are not driven by inflation but by policy normalization, leading to reduced equity risk appetite and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production below 98.0 index points signals weakening manufacturing activity and deteriorating business conditions, which reduces corporate earnings expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 98.0, or the average return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A persistent increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) above 460 billion dollars, combined with rising employment (PAYEMS), indicates strong aggregate demand that supports corporate revenue growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction term is not significant (p > 0.05) in a regression model.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in non-farm payroll growth exceeding 200,000 jobs per month, combined with a declining unemployment rate, signals a labor market overheating that triggers Fed tightening expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the interaction effect is not significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 0.66% with stable CPIAUCSL (within ±0.5 index points) indicates a neutral-to-tight monetary policy stance that reduces liquidity and raises discount rates, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the interaction effect is not significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained expansion in real GDP (GDPC1) above 1.5% annualized growth, combined with rising residential construction (HOUST), indicates a robust economic expansion that supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in less than 60% of instances despite the signal, or the interaction term is not significant (p > 0.05).
